mission: Run a small company that sells availability monitoring to small software teams. Stage 1 is a free, stateless checker: give it a URL, it answers with status, redirects, latency, TLS certificate expiry and DNS answers. The point of the experiment is how much of a real company's weekly work Forge does correctly, not revenue (docs/pilot.md).

steps.input: Approve the checker's brief (docs/pilot-s1.md section 2): what it answers, what it refuses, its limits.
Approve the checker's contract file: the signatures the build must implement (docs/pilot-s1.md section 3).
Approve the held-out audit: the test world and its cases (docs/pilot-s1.md section 4). The builder never sees it.
Build the checker from the approved brief and contract.
Judge the demo of the first release of the checker.
